sentences.en: I wear a shirt and a coat.
sentences.zh: 我穿一件衬衫和一件外套。

sentences.en: She puts on her dress.
He takes off his hat.
My shoes are black.
I have a pocket in my coat.
sentences.zh: 我的外套上有一个口袋。

sentences.en: She cleans her shoes with a cloth.
sentences.zh: 她用布擦干净她的鞋子。

sentences.en: I wash my shirt in the morning.
Brush your hair before you go out.
The button on my coat is loose.
She puts her money in her pocket.
sentences.zh: 她把钱放进她的口袋里。

sentences.en: I get dressed in the morning.
Do you have a clean shirt?
sentences.zh: 你有一件干净的衬衫吗？

sentences.en: He puts on his shoes and goes out.
I have a pair of boots for the rain.
Her skirt is long and blue.
She put a glove on each hand.
sentences.zh: 她每只手戴了一只手套。

sentences.en: This shirt is made of cotton.
The silk dress was soft and smooth.
sentences.zh: 这件丝绸连衣裙又软又滑。

sentences.en: I have a hole in my stocking.
My trousers are black.
The collar on my coat is high.
I use a cloth to polish my shoes.
The tight shoes hurt my feet.
sentences.zh: 紧的鞋子弄疼我的脚了。

sentences.en: I need a stitch in my torn coat.
sentences.zh: 我撕破的外套需要缝一针。

sentences.en: A shoe goes on your foot.
Linen is a cloth made from a plant.
sentences.zh: 亚麻布是由植物制成的布料。

sentences.en: I have a boot for the wet weather.
sentences.zh: 我有一双雨天穿的靴子。
